features.definition: Days with maximum temperature at least 90Â°F (32.2Â°C).

features.label: Mean commute
features.definition: Grouped ACS duration estimate; commuting proxy, not measured congestion.

features.label: Public DC charging
features.definition: Operational public DC ports divided by population times 100,000. Not secured fleet capacity.

features.label: County charging coverage
features.definition: Population share in counties with at least one operational public DC port; not travel-time access.

features.label: Resident population
features.definition: ACS resident population; not observed ride-hailing demand.

features.label: Population density
features.definition: Population divided by CBSA land area excluding water.

features.label: Zero-vehicle households
features.definition: Households without an available vehicle divided by all households.

features.label: Transit commute share
features.definition: Public transit commuters divided by applicable workers; transit also competes with ride-hailing.

exclusions: No verified public-data release has been published. All displayed ranking measurements are synthetic.
